cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.
